item.tib: tshogs mchod yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyud bskang
item.coloph: rdzus dge bshes kyis bskul te drung mu ha ras bkod pa dge'o/ 'di la 'dra min 'dug pas drung mu ha ras mdzad pa bzhin bshus nas dag cing khungs btsun pa byin rlabs 'byung ngo / de min bcos lhad kyi don g.yel bas 'jog par zhu/ dge sbyong gi nyams len ngang nas zhus//
